newsitem.title: USA: Nuevo Energy sets exploration off Ghana.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo Energy sets exploration off Ghana.

text.p: Nuevo Energy Co said Monday it signed a Petroleum Agreement with the Republic of Ghana and Ghana National Petroleum Corp for petroleum rights covering some 1.7 million acres offshore Ghana in the East Cape Three Points Prospect Area.
Nuevo is the operator with a 75 percent working interest and Yukong Ltd holds the remaining 25 percent working interest.
"To put the enormous size of this contract area into perspective, it is equal to approximately 350 Gulf of Mexico offshore blocks," Nuevo President Mike Watford pointed out.
"This contract area includes numerous large structures which appear analogous to nearby producing fields at Cote d'Ivoire and affords Nuevo significant exploration potential."
Current 1997 plans include reprocessing existing seismic and shooting additional seismic in preparation for drilling the first exploration well in 1998.
